quarterly_data.quarter: Apple press release: Apple unveils iPhone Duo (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Apple introduced iPhone Duo, 'the first foldable iPhone', with a 7.6-inch inner display (50 percent larger than iPhone 18 Pro Max) and a 5.4-inch outer display. It is powered by A20 Pro (the same chip as the iPhone 18 Pro models, built on the latest 2-nanometer process technology) in 'a new chip package inspired by M-series Apple silicon' that connects A20 Pro directly to a custom vapor chamber, for up to 35 percent better sustained performance than iPhone 17 Pro; dual-battery design, N1 wireless chip and C2 cellular modem, eSIM-only worldwide. CEO John Ternus: 'iPhone Duo is the most transformational change to iPhone since the original.' Pre-orders begin October 16 with availability October 23 in more than 70 countries and regions (28 more on October 30); starts at $1,999 in 256GB, 512GB, 1TB and 2TB capacities; ships with iOS 27.1.
quarterly_data.figure: first foldable iPhone; A20 Pro (2-nanometer); availability October 23; starts at $1,999
